subject: Decision Making
title: The Ask-the-Audience Lifeline
description: Learn The Ask-the-Audience Lifeline in one minute.

hook.text: On Who Wants to Be a Millionaire, the audience gets it right 91 percent of the time. Phone-a-friend: only 65 percent.

buildup.text: The audience is diverse, answers independently via keypad, and the votes are aggregated.

discovery.text: No single audience member needs to know the answer. Enough partial knowledge across the group produces a correct.

twist.text: In countries where audiences coordinate via hand signals, the accuracy drops.

climax.text: Ask-the-Audience is a live demonstration of crowd wisdom theory.

punchline.text: 91 percent accuracy from strangers. Independent crowds beat individual experts.

quiz.question: Why does Ask-the-Audience work so well on game shows?
options: Independent answers from a diverse crowd aggregate into high accuracy
